scope: All retained precursor columns, CV folds and text IDs
All native fragment values and CSR offsets
All native index entries, bin metadata, mappings and hints

prior_prototype.timing_limit: One fresh-process run per mode, including first-call compilation after imports; not a speedup claim.

limitations: Clean reference is not wired into normal BuildSpecLib/SearchDIA; Nathan must integrate all readers and writers together.
New codecs have no legacy readers or runtime loader replacement.
No raw data or prediction caches are committed.
Fixed protein/configuration files excluded from measured byte totals.
Tiny tryptic controls are dominated by fixed overhead.
